Objective
Statutory objective 
of the organisation.
What does the 
organisation seek 
to achieve?
Outline of the policy plan
Please answer the questions below or provide an URL to the policy plan after the last question about the policy plan.
The online policy plan should at least provide answers to the questions about the policy plan asked here.
What are the 
institution’s activities? 
When are which 
acitvities to be carried 
out? And how do the 
activities contribute 
to achieving the 
institution’s objective?
How does the 
organisation generate 
income or revenue?
As per the official statutes, Article 3: Purpose and activities - "The Association has the 
non-profit international purpose to coordinate all the natural and legal persons and 
associations based throughout the European Union and beyond, which form and 
promote the transnational and pan-European political movement Volt, based on the 
Volt Charter with the goal to register as a European political party and will hence act in 
view of reaching:
- a united Europe that values its citizens and residents, who are able to fulfill their 
unique potential and continuously strive to achieve together the highest standards of 
human, social, environmental, and technical development;
- a society where individuals have the rights to choose how they want to lead their life 
- a state that is the guarantor for the rights of every individual
- a free and open market economy,economy
- a strengthened European identity, complementary to the national and local ones, to 
foster a sense of solidarity, cooperation, and belonging in the European people"
We work towards a united, federal Europe where everyone has equal chances to fulfil 
their unique potential. By uniting our strengths democratically, we strive to form a 
strong, responsible and transparent European government that acts in the interest of 
all Europeans.
We believe in reforming Europe to build a true European democracy. We are working 
towards building a stronger European Parliament with the power of proposing new 
laws and electing a European Prime Minister, that will be held accountable in front of 
all European citizens. We think we can shape Europe into a society where the highest 
standards of human, social, environmental, and technical development are achieved. 
Our goal is to get our own political faction in the European Parliament in 2024. Volt 
competed in the European Elections in 2019 for the first time and we led a 
cross-border election campaign with a European election programme. 
Volt Europa is generating its income primarily through membership fees and donations. 
All donations above EUR 3'000 (per calendar year) are published on our transparency 
website: https://www.volteuropa.org/transparency

How and for what 
purposes are the 
revenues spent? 
If your organisation holds 
capital, please fill in here 
where and how this capital 
is held (e.g. savings 
account, investments, etc.)
Volt spends the revenues on building the organisation, which prepares and supports 
elections. Most notably the European Parliament elections. Volt Europa also supports 
the national chapters in their preparations for elections and political participation in 
general. Expenses are spent on personnel, information technology and events mainly. 
If yearly revenues are not exhausted they are dedicated to the reserves and included 
in the expenses of coming years. Volt Europa holds all reserves in checking accounts. 
https://www.volteuropa.org/policy-portfolio
Open
From the Internal Regulations, 2.2.3.6 Remuneration and expenses (Art. 16)
(a) Unless the Assembly decides otherwise, the Directors are not remunerated for their 
activities related to the Association.
(b) Board members may incur expenses linked to the budget approved by the General 
Assembly, under the control of the Treasurer. 
General: Running Pan-European Communications Campaigns, Organising European 
events (Volt Meets Volt Europa on a bi-monthly basis,General Assemblies), 
formulation of Pan-European policies, engagement of members, growing member base 
and presence across Europe, providing community organising and electoral candidate 
training for 2024 European elections. 
Open
